{{Quote|Fresh Sizhranian lettuce tossed with Hocekureem Sea salt croutons. Fit for a Falleen prince!|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="dad" />}}
'''Xizor salad''' was a type of [[Salad/Legends|salad]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], for the price of 7.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]],<ref name="dad" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> It was made from fresh, [[Laser/Legends|laser]]-cut [[Sizhranian lettuce/Legends|Sizhranian lettuce]], tossed with [[Hocekureem Sea salt crouton]]s and all sourced from [[VegSatellite]]s orbiting Coruscant. The menu itself lauded the dish as being fit to serve to a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]], being amongst the tastiest dishes that the diner's [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] had ever tasted.<ref name="dad" />

The salad was also served at the [[Riverview Café]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Varlo]]<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> world [[Roonadan]],<ref name="Ascension" /> and in [[44 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] considered ordering a portion of the salad alongside [[Roba steak/Legends|Roba steak]] and a dessert of [[Vagnerian canapé]]s while dining in the café.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|At its most basic level, this thinking led to a number of puns&mdash;Panna cakes, Wol Cabasshews, Xizor salad, Sic-Six-layer cake, Tibanna split and Shili cheese dog among them&mdash;that are either inspired or stupid or both, depending on one's sense of humor.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
[[Gregory Walker]], the author of the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," created Xizor salad as a joke, naming it as both a pun on [[Wikipedia:Caesar salad|Caesar salad]] and a reference to Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] from [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'']].<ref name="blog" />
